text:
melissa: Heads up — audit-validator CI flagged multiple failures on master after the RBAC schema rollout. Looks like golden fixtures are out of sync with the new event envelope.
melissa: This is customer-facing audit output so we should triage quickly.
ci-bot: Build #2891 failed — audit-validator (unit/regression) -> 12 errors. https://ci.internal/builds/2891 (artifacts attached) :warning:
omar: I pulled the logs — most failures are schema mismatches around event.actor / resource.principal and a new kms.key_id on some events. Example from validator: 
```
ERROR: audit_validator: mismatch at path event.actor -> expected object, got string "service:gateway"
ERROR: audit_validator: missing required property event.kms.key_id for event.type=key_rotation
```
kai: tagging this for triage. my initial options: rollback rbac-schema change, or add a short-term compatibility shim in validator to accept both shapes.
maria: +1 on a compatibility shim. We should also update golden fixtures and add a unit test per fixture so CI will catch regressions earlier.
judy: any chance KMS change was unintended? The PR that landed also touched KMS envelope enrichment. If kms.key_id was introduced without a migration, that'd explain the break.
omar: I'll attach the failing artifacts and the minimal reproduction. Opening an issue now and linking failures: https://ci.internal/builds/2891/artifacts/fail-log.txt
melissa: Action items: 1) short-term validator shim to accept both actor formats, 2) bump and regenerate golden fixtures for affected endpoints, 3) add explicit CI gate that flags schema-only PRs without bumping fixtures or adding a migration note. Assigning to @maria and @omar to drive the fix. :thumbsup:
kai: also recommend we add a one-line changelog entry in the PR template reminding devs to run `tools/update-audit-fixtures` when changing envelope fields.
maria: sounds good — I'll take the shim + fixture updates. Will open PR by EOD and include the failing artifact links and tests.
judy: I'll follow up on the KMS enrichment PR and confirm whether the change was intentional or rolled out accidentally.
ci-bot: Issue created: ENGSEC-1729 (audit-validator regression) by omar.
maria: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/audit-validator/pulls/402 — includes compatibility shim, updated fixtures, and new per-fixture tests. Please review.
melissa: Thanks all — once PR merges let's monitor the canary deploy and validate downstream customer logs. If anything else pops up, ping #eng-oncall. :eyes:
